'''Alema Rar's first lightsaber''' was constructed by [[Padawan|Jedi Padawan]] [[Alema Rar]], alongside her sister, [[Numa Rar]]. It used by Alema during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] until it was destroyed in 27 ABY aboard the ''[[Nebula Chaser]]'' when it was thrown into a [[disintegration chute]] alongside Numa's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. The two [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] sisters recovered their lightsabers' silver Adegan crystals and used then to power their second lightsabers.
